|quest_reward4_quest = Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Static Strike''' is a [[melee]] [[strike]] [[attack]] [[active skill|skill]] that builds up static energy on you whenever you strike an enemy, dealing damage to nearby enemies while you have energy stored. ==Mechanics== * '''Static energy:''' The initial hit applies static energy to the player, activating the beam effect for a base [[duration]] of 4 seconds. * '''Chain:''' The beams possess the [[Chaining]] tag, start with +1 chain,https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2513456 and can benefit from sources of additional chains such as {{il|Chain Support}} and {{il|Touch of Anguish}}. * '''Melee:''' The beams qualify as melee damage, making Static Strike capable of maintaining effects like {{il|Fortify Support}}. *'''Area of Effect:''' The beams are affected by increases or reductions to Area of Effect, but aren't affected by increases or reductions to Area Damage. The base area of effect is 2.5m. *'''Beam damage''' is considered damage from the attack that granted static energy. Properties that apply to entire attacks such as {{il|Ruthless Support}}, or exertion by {{il|Intimidating Cry}} or {{il|Ambush}}, will apply to both the strike and the beams for their full duration, unless removed by beams from a new attack. Beams do not [[snapshot]] regular offensive stats or [[buff]]s. ===Interactions=== {{il|General's Cry}}: beams will continue to activate from their final location even after mirage warriors vanish. {{il|Phase Run}}: can be activated after gaining static energy to buff the beams' physical damage. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_header = # maximum Beam Targets |c1_abbr = Beam
